# 🧯 Postmortem

## Summary
Incident, time window, affected demos and impact.

## Timeline
Include timezone and source of each observation.

## Detection and response
How detected, what worked and what delayed recovery.

## Root cause
Technical and process contributors, without personal blame.

## What went well / poorly
Evidence-based findings.

## Corrective actions
| Action | Priority | Owner | Due | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Follow-up
Link issues, commits, docs and tests. Remove private data from attachments.
